Tramway

An internationally renowned arts venue housed in a vast former tram depot on the Southside. Tramway’s cavernous industrial spaces host cutting-edge theatre, dance, and visual art from Scotland and around the world. Its programme leans towards the experimental and the boundary-pushing.
